Summary: etcd is prone to an information disclosure vulnerability.
Affected Software/OS: etcd prior to version 3.4.26 and version 3.5.x through 3.5.8.
Vulnerability Insight:
LeaseTimeToLive API allows access to key names (not value)
  associated to a lease when Keys parameter is true, even a user doesn't have read permission to
  the keys. The impact is limited to a cluster which enables auth (RBAC).
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Checks if a vulnerable version is present on the target host.
